align.zh-CN: 对话布局方式，可选 leftRight（左右分布）或 leftAlign（左对齐）。

chats.zh-CN: 受控对话消息列表，配合 onChatsChange 使用。
chats.en-US: Controlled list of conversation messages; use it together with onChatsChange.

dialogueRenderConfig.zh-CN: 自定义各区块的渲染，可替换头像、标题、内容、操作栏或整条对话。
dialogueRenderConfig.en-US: Custom rendering of the dialogue parts: avatar, title, content, action bar or the whole dialogue.

disabledFileItemClick.zh-CN: 是否禁用文件卡片的点击。
disabledFileItemClick.en-US: Whether clicking a file card is disabled.

escapeHtml.zh-CN: 是否转义用户消息中的 HTML 标签，避免被 Markdown 解析器当作 HTML 处理而丢失内容。
escapeHtml.en-US: Whether to escape HTML tags in user messages, so the Markdown parser does not treat them as HTML and drop content.

hintCls.en-US: Class name of the outermost hint area element.

hints.zh-CN: 提示信息。点击某条提示后，它成为新的用户消息，并触发 onHintClick。
hints.en-US: Hint texts. Clicking a hint turns it into a new user message and calls onHintClick.

hintStyle.en-US: Style of the outermost hint area element.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 透传给每条消息所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，raw 由消息决定，不可传入；components 与内置组件合并，同名的（如 code）覆盖内置组件。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender of each message. raw is decided by the message and cannot be passed; components are merged with the built-in ones, and a component with the same name (such as code) replaces the built-in one.

messageEditRender.zh-CN: 用户消息处于编辑状态时显示的编辑器，参数为消息转换得到的输入内容。
messageEditRender.en-US: The editor shown while a user message is being edited; its parameter is the input content converted from the message.

mode.zh-CN: 对话模式，可选 bubble、noBubble 或 userBubble。
mode.en-US: Conversation mode: bubble, noBubble or userBubble.

onAnnotationClick.zh-CN: 点击参考来源时调用，参数为被点击消息块的注释数组。
onAnnotationClick.en-US: Called when the references of a message block are clicked, with that block's annotations.

onChatsChange.zh-CN: 消息列表变化时调用，参数为新的消息数组。
onChatsChange.en-US: Called when the message list changes, with the new message array.

onFileClick.zh-CN: 点击文件卡片时调用，参数为该文件。
onFileClick.en-US: Called when a file card is clicked, with the file.

onHintClick.zh-CN: 点击提示词时调用，参数为该提示文本。
onHintClick.en-US: Called when a hint is clicked, with the hint text.

onImageClick.zh-CN: 点击图片时调用，参数为该图片。
onImageClick.en-US: Called when an image is clicked, with the image.

onMessageBadFeedback.zh-CN: 对消息点踩时调用，参数为该消息。
onMessageBadFeedback.en-US: Called when a message is disliked, with the message.

onMessageCopy.zh-CN: 复制消息时调用：文本写入剪贴板成功后才调用，复制的文本不含推理内容；没有可复制的文本时既不写入也不调用。
onMessageCopy.en-US: Called when a message is copied, after the text has been written to the clipboard successfully. The copied text excludes reasoning; a message without text is neither written nor reported.

onMessageDelete.zh-CN: 删除消息时调用，参数为该消息。
onMessageDelete.en-US: Called when a message is deleted, with the message.

onMessageEdit.zh-CN: 编辑消息时调用，参数为该消息。
onMessageEdit.en-US: Called when a message is edited, with the message.

onMessageGoodFeedback.zh-CN: 对消息点赞时调用，参数为该消息。
onMessageGoodFeedback.en-US: Called when a message is liked, with the message.

onMessageReset.zh-CN: 重置消息时调用，参数为该消息。
onMessageReset.en-US: Called when a message is reset, with the message.

onMessageShare.zh-CN: 分享消息时调用，参数为该消息。
onMessageShare.en-US: Called when a message is shared, with the message.

onReferenceClick.zh-CN: 引用按钮点击时调用。参数没有 id，加入 AIChatInput 的 references 前由使用方补上；文件项没有 type。
onReferenceClick.en-US: Called when a reference button is clicked. The argument has no id, which the caller adds before putting it into the references of AIChatInput; a file item has no type.

onSelect.zh-CN: 选中的消息变化时调用，参数为选中消息的 id 数组。
onSelect.en-US: Called when the selected messages change, with the ids of the selected messages.

ref.zh-CN: 接收根元素 div，其上带有下方 Methods 表中的方法。
ref.en-US: Receives the root div element, which carries the methods listed in the Methods table.

renderDialogueContentItem.zh-CN: 按内容项类型返回渲染内容的映射。嵌套的工具调用按名称索引，纯文本消息使用键 default。
renderDialogueContentItem.en-US: Renderers keyed by content item type. A tool call is indexed by its name inside its type, and a plain-text message uses the key default.

renderHintBox.zh-CN: 自定义提示项的渲染，参数含提示文本 `content`、序号 `index` 与点击回调 `onHintClick`。
renderHintBox.en-US: Custom rendering of each hint item, with the hint text `content`, its `index` and the click callback `onHintClick`.

roleConfig.zh-CN: 各角色（user、assistant、system 等）的名称、头像与头像颜色，必填，不读取全局默认值。
roleConfig.en-US: Name, avatar and avatar color of each role (user, assistant, system and so on). Required, and not read from the global defaults.

showReset.en-US: Whether to show the reset action.

showReference.zh-CN: 是否在文字或文件消息中展示可被引用的图标，仅对用户消息生效。
showReference.en-US: Whether to show the reference icon on text or file messages. Only user messages are affected.

scrollToBottom.zh-CN: 滚动到最底部，参数为 true 时带动画。
scrollToBottom.en-US: Scrolls to the bottom, animated when the argument is true.

scrollToTop.zh-CN: 滚动到最顶部，参数为 true 时带动画。
scrollToTop.en-US: Scrolls to the top, animated when the argument is true.

customRenderer.zh-CN: 替换推理正文的渲染。参数为推理组件的全部属性，返回的内容放在正文区域中。
customRenderer.en-US: Replaces the rendering of the reasoning text. It receives all props of the component, and its result goes into the content area.

markdownRenderProps.zh-CN: 透传给推理正文所用 MarkdownRender 的属性，raw 由推理正文决定。
markdownRenderProps.en-US: Props passed to the MarkdownRender of the reasoning text; raw comes from the reasoning text.

status.zh-CN: 推理状态。为 completed 时标题显示已完成，且初次渲染时折叠；其他值显示思考中并展开。
status.en-US: Reasoning status. completed shows the finished title and starts collapsed; any other value shows the thinking title and starts expanded.

summary.zh-CN: 推理摘要，非空时按换行拼接其中的文本作为推理正文。
summary.en-US: Reasoning summary. When it is not empty, its texts joined by line breaks form the reasoning text.

content.zh-CN: 推理内容，summary 为空时按换行拼接其中的文本作为推理正文。
content.en-US: Reasoning content. When summary is empty, its texts joined by line breaks form the reasoning text.

steps.zh-CN: 步骤列表，必填。每个步骤含 summary、status 与 actions，status 为 completed 时显示完成图标，否则显示加载中；actions 每项含 summary、description 与 icon，步骤有操作时可点击或用 Enter、空格展开收起。
steps.en-US: List of steps, required. Each step has summary, status and actions; completed shows the done icon, any other status shows loading. Each action has summary, description and icon, and a step with actions expands or collapses on click, Enter or Space.

annotation.zh-CN: 参考来源列表，每项可含 title、logo、url、detail。必填。
annotation.en-US: List of references; each item may have title, logo, url and detail. Required.

description.zh-CN: 来源图标后的描述文字，不传时显示来源数量。
description.en-US: Text after the source logos; the number of references is shown when it is not set.

maxCount.zh-CN: 最多显示的来源图标数，超出部分显示为 +N。必填。
maxCount.en-US: Maximum number of source logos shown; the rest are shown as +N. Required.

onClick.zh-CN: 点击或用 Enter、空格激活时调用，参数为事件与参考来源列表。
onClick.en-US: Called on click or on activation with Enter or Space, with the event and the references.
